formulas.linear_cka: Kornblith et al. 2019 eqs. 3-4: HSIC(K,L) = tr(KHLH)/(n-1)^2, CKA = HSIC(K,L)/sqrt(HSIC(K,K) HSIC(L,L)); linear kernels: ||Yc^T Xc||_F^2 / (||Xc^T Xc||_F ||Yc^T Yc||_F), columns centred over the rows used (biased estimator, as in the paper)
formulas.centred_kta: Cortes, Mohri & Rostamizadeh 2012 Definition 4 / Lemma 1: rho(K,K') = <Kc,K'c>_F/(||Kc||_F ||K'c||_F), Kc = [I - 11^T/m] K [I - 11^T/m]; target kernel Y Y^T (paper: y y^T for scalar labels; the one-hot N/S/V target is our multiclass extension); equals CKA(X, Y) for K = X X^T
formulas.geometric_difference: Huang et al. 2021 main-text eq. 5 g(K1||K2) = sqrt(||sqrt(K2) K1^-1 sqrt(K2)||_inf), Tr K = N; rank-deficient linear kernels need the regularised form of the SI (arXiv:2011.01938v2 eqs. F19-F20, L8-L10): g_gen(K_C||K_Q) = sqrt(||sqrt(K_Q) sqrt(K_C)(K_C+lam I)^-2 sqrt(K_C) sqrt(K_Q)||_inf), g_tra = lam sqrt(||sqrt(K_Q)(K_C+lam I)^-2 sqrt(K_Q)||_inf); resid = lim lam->0 g_tra^2 (K_Q outside K_C's span). Paper: grid lam in {1e-5,1e-4,1e-3,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.1}, report g_gen at the largest lam with g_tra < 0.045 (min over classical kernels); engineered datasets: g_tra^2 s_Q <= 0.002. Caveat: pdftotext loses Greek letters and radicals; the formula was reconstructed from equation structure, the stated lam = 0 limit and s_C <= g^2 s_Q, and checked numerically against dense sqrtm/inv code (1e-9).

deviations_from_card: four reference maps added (qrc_shot1001, qrc_res1, mf_exact, esn_res1) to calibrate 'near 1'
CKA and KTA also on all DS1 units, besides the declared stratified subsample

geometric difference: the paper's lam grid plus 1.0; g_tra and the out-of-span residual added (the regularised g_gen alone is misleading for rank-deficient kernels); extra noiseless pair qrc_exact vs mf_exact
interpretation: Diagnostic, DS1 only; cannot show quantum advantage. Supports A016 at the representation level: the mean-field map is as close to the QRC as the QRC is to itself re-measured with another shot seed or rebuilt with another reservoir seed (CKA, g_gen at every lam, g_tra, residual), and in the noiseless limit the kernels nearly coincide. The QRC's per-record KTA edge over mean-field matches its edge over its own seed-1 draw. Does not support: any quantum advantage (these are linear kernels on measured expectations, not Tr(rho rho')); predictions of trained-readout F1 from KTA (unweighted kernel dominated by top PCs; separable has the highest KTA yet lower ds2s V F1 per A016); any test-patient claim.
